name: אַדְמָה
summary: Admah is a city on the Canaanite boundary, named with Sodom, Gomorrah and Zeboiim; Shinab was its king. The text gives no derivation of the name.

evidence.note: The boundary description names Admah in the sequence “Sodom and Gomorrah and Admah and Zeboiim.”
Shinab bears the title מֶלֶךְ אַדְמָה, “king of Admah.”

note: Moved from the former word entry `2ademaah`. The old root key אדמה recorded the place name’s consonants. Its historical derivation is uncertain; whether it is the noun אֲדָמָה “ground” is not shown.
